summary: eXoZymes Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K on October 9, 2026, under Items 8.01 (Other Events) and 9.01 (Financial Statements and Exhibits), disclosing an investor presentation dated October 6, 2026. The presentation may be provided to investment bankers, other offering participants, and current or potential investors in the Company's securities. No transaction terms, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or closing date are stated. The filing is an ordinary investor-relations disclosure rather than a special situation; no deal or structural mechanics are disclosed.
